functionalPasses.result: Quote, reservation replay, Razorpay initialization, order replay, confirmed order, and two-ticket wallet projection passed
Login, reload persistence, ticket wallet, logout, and protected redirect passed

defects.finding: Cold /explore navigation exceeded the 20000ms crawler timeout. Gateway telemetry measured both public events and featured-event reads at approximately 20800ms.
defects.requiredRemediation: Make the public discovery cold path cache-ready and bounded so the first route load meets the sub-3-second target.

defects.finding: The browser surfaced SIGNAL TIMED OUT during reservation. Gateway authentication consumed approximately 10225ms and the reservation completed only after the UI had failed, preventing Razorpay initialization.
defects.requiredRemediation: Remove repeated cold authentication/provider work from the checkout mutation path and preserve deterministic request recovery.

defects.finding: Direct commerce behavior was correct, but cold Razorpay/order initiation took 6054.92ms.
defects.requiredRemediation: Keep idempotency and atomic order semantics while reducing the initiation critical path below 3000ms.

defects.finding: Promoter analytics rendered correctly but took 5352ms and the canonical analytics endpoint recomputed Firestore link, daily-bucket, overview, and ledger projections without the Host/Venue Redis response cache.
defects.requiredRemediation: Add bounded Redis caching and mutation invalidation for promoter analytics and link option reads.

defects.finding: Recommendations v2 returned ten HTTP 200 responses but failed the sub-3-second SLA at p95 7724.07ms; the other eight sampled endpoint groups passed.
defects.requiredRemediation: Make recommendation cache bootstrap and cold computation bounded while retaining per-user invalidation after recommendation signals.

defects.finding: Core cache reads and writes can run while ioredis is still connecting with enableOfflineQueue disabled, producing Stream isn't writeable misses before the connection-ready event.
defects.requiredRemediation: Centralize a bounded readiness wait for cache operations so cold requests can use Redis without enabling an unbounded offline queue.
